Sound familiar?

You open the pantry and there it is: tiny black droppings next to the cereal.

At 2am you hear it, scratching inside the wall right behind your headboard.

You set traps. You catch one. A week later the droppings are back under the sink.

Now you're wiping down counters before you cook, checking the kids' snacks, and wondering what's chewing on the wiring in the garage.

It isn't that you aren't trying hard enough. Traps and poison were never built to stop the next mouse.

The real reason they come back

The Scent Trail Cycle

Mice barely use their eyes to get around your home. They follow their noses.

Every mouse that gets in leaves a trail of pheromones and urine behind it, an invisible highway from the gap under your door to the food in your pantry. Every new mouse picks up that trail and follows it straight in.

When a trap catches one mouse, the highway stays open. The next one arrives, follows the same trail, and the cycle starts over. That's why "it worked for a week" is the most common story with traps.

To stop mice for good, break the trail at the entry points. Catching whichever mouse walks down it won't do it.

The fix

That's why we built the 4-Oil Barrier

Peppermint oil · 40%Overwhelms a mouse's sense of smell on contact, so it can't read the trail and backs away.
Cinnamon oil · 5%Masks the pheromone trails, so new mice can't find the path in.
Cedarwood oil · 4%Makes the area unattractive for nesting.
Castor-oil base · 5%Releases the blend slowly, so one pouch keeps working for up to 90 days.

Each pouch creates a barrier of roughly 65 sq. ft. Place one at every entry point and the highway is closed.

FAQ

How long does it actually take to work?

Most customers notice mice activity dropping within 72 hours. By week two, entry points are fully blocked and pheromone trails destroyed. By week three, mice have completely abandoned the property. Results vary depending on how severe the infestation is and how many entry points you have.

Will it really keep them gone or just move them temporarily?

Yes - completely. If mice don't leave within 30 days, Contact Us and we'll refund you in full. No forms, no hassle, no questions asked. You risk nothing.

Is it actually safe around my dog / grandkids / livestock?

100%. No poison, no chemicals, no neurotoxins of any kind. The formula is built entirely from natural oils — peppermint, cinnamon, cedarwood and our castor oil. Completely harmless to humans and animals. Only mice find it unbearable.

How many do I need and where do I put them?

It depends on what you're protecting. A single room or RV needs 1 pack. A full home needs 2 packs. A large home with a garage or barn needs 3 packs. Place pouches every 8–10 feet along known entry points — doors, windows, under sinks, behind appliances, basement corners. The more entry points you cover, the faster it works.

What if it doesn't work — can I get my money back?

Yes — completely. If mice don't leave within 30 days, Contact Us and we'll refund you in full. No forms, no hassle, no questions asked. You risk nothing.

How is this different from the peppermint spray I already tried?

Concentration and delivery. Store-bought sprays contain less than 1% peppermint oil and evaporate within hours. Get Rid Of pouches contain an 8% concentration formula held in a castor oil base that releases slowly and consistently for 90 days straight. There's no comparison.

How long does one pouch last?

90 days. Our castor oil carrier base ensures slow, consistent release — maintaining full potency for the entire 90-day period without any reapplying or topping up. Just replace every 90 days for continuous protection.

Do I need to do anything or just place it?

Just place it. No setup, no baiting, no checking, no resetting. Place pouches at entry points and the formula does everything else. The only thing you need to remember is replacing them every 90 days.

When will my order ship?

Usually within 1 business day. US delivery typically takes 5–12 business days.

Can I cancel Automatic Refills?

Anytime, from your account or by emailing support@getridof.shop. There's no minimum and no fee.
